g.text: When do earlier models actually stop?
Paired diagnostic: same 27 graphs × 30 counts per model; opened panel, not independent confirmation.
Legacy LoRA differs in data/recipe/capacity. Other four arms have bitwise identical non-controller tensors.
Blue = graph fraction on a log color scale; blank = zero; red = desired stop. No-stop row is separate from cap successes.
